title: Nearest Value to Target
summary: Return the list value closest to target, choosing the smaller value on ties, or None when empty.
statement: Return the list value closest to target, choosing the smaller value on ties, or None when empty. Implement `nearest_value_to_target` and return the required result without changing the callable signature.
constraints: Inputs follow the declared Python and JSON-compatible types.
Return a deterministic result for every valid input.
reference_solution:
def nearest_value_to_target(nums, target):
    return min(nums, key=lambda value: (abs(value-target), value)) if nums else None
brute_force_solution:
